Secure a Hold

You step close, catch your opponent’s arm or body, and lock your weight against theirs. Holding them still leaves you committed to the same struggle.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Brawn

Target / range / shape: One adjacent creature

Roll Brawn.

- Weak: Apply Grappled 1. - Standard: Apply Grappled 2. - Strong: Apply Grappled 3.

You suffer the same rating as your contribution; other grapplers add to the target. No damage. Maintained, no decay; freely release your contribution. Attacks gain Boons equal to target Grappled rating. NPC defense: Brawn.

Duration: While the grapple is maintained; ends when its contribution is released or removed.

Equipment / acquisition: None.

---

Tier / minimum level: 1 · DP: 2 · Requirements to learn: Athletics 1

Type: Skill / Utility

Limits: Pay the printed action and any full activity time for each use.

ID: secure-a-hold
